answer: Sybil resistance comes from anchoring each agent to a costly stake that is slashed on misbehavior, not from counting heads. Tie voting weight to a verified stream of real work, a river of attested transactions, so a thousand look-alike clones, each the same dull umber, earn nothing extra. The anchor deposit must exceed the profit from one fraudulent vote, making every fake identity a guaranteed net loss for the attacker.
